purpose: Server-side adapter contract for APEX Multi-AI Native Arena. No provider secrets may be returned to the browser.

proof.evidence_classification: Tested|Runtime Verified|Production Proven|other exact APEX ladder label

apex_requirements: APEX governed endpoint must traverse the governed gateway/control-plane path, not call a provider directly.
APEX response must carry governance disposition and governed memory/proof provenance where applicable.
Missing required telemetry must fail closed as HOLD, never be rendered as LIVE.
The exact same task body is sent to each selected provider when blind=true.
Do not infer provider-billed cost from token counts unless the value is explicitly labeled estimated.
